title: Model protocol states explicitly until typestate is available
summary: A closed Union documents protocol alternatives, but current Topal cannot make an operation consume one state and return the next.
recommendation: Represent meaningful protocol alternatives explicitly and validate every operation boundary until affine state-indexed capabilities are available.
rationale: A Boolean connection flag cannot express all protocol alternatives; a union makes the model reviewable even though it does not provide typestate enforcement.
confidence: The rule recognizes protocol-named Boolean state and protocol-named unions. It cannot prove operation ordering, ownership transfer, peer behavior, or liveness.
exceptions: A Boolean is appropriate for a genuinely binary connection fact.
A union model remains runtime-checked until the language provides affine state-indexed capabilities.
provenance: Design-pattern catalog AP-04; lint plan approved 2026-09-30
